basic.name: 普通攻击：打年糕
basic.trigger: 点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
basic.description:
点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
向前方进行至多三段攻击，造成物理伤害。
basic.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] to activate:
Unleashes up to 3 attacks, dealing Physical DMG.

special.name: 特殊技：吹凉便当
special.trigger: 点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
special.description:
点按 【特殊技键】 发动：
向前方扇出风场，随后释放终结一击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间长按 【特殊技键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
special.descriptionEn:
Press [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku releases a wind current in front of her and unleashes her finishing move, dealing Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

ex.name: 强化特殊技：扇走蚊虫
ex.trigger: 能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
ex.triggerEn: With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
ex.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方扇出范围更远的风场，造成大量冰属性伤害；
多次点按可以连续发动招式，每次发动时将消耗一定能量，能量不足或停止点按时会自动释放终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间长按 【特殊技键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
ex.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill can be triggered consecutively by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

dodgeCounter.name: 闪避反击：别抢零食
dodgeCounter.nameEn: Dodge Counter: Away From My Snacks
dodgeCounter.trigger: 触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
dodgeCounter.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
dodgeCounter.description:
触发[极限闪避]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
dodgeCounter.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] during a Perfect Dodge to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

chain.name: 连携技：鹅鸡斩
chain.trigger: 触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
chain.triggerEn: When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
chain.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速对前方敌人发动多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
chain.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes a series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

ultimate.name: 终结技：大份鹅鸡斩
ultimate.trigger: 喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
ultimate.triggerEn: When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
ultimate.description:
喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速对前方敌人发动更多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，苍角会进入[鬼面]状态，使自身的暴击率提升15%，持续15秒；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes an extended series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Soukaku enters the Masked state, increasing her CRIT Rate by 15% for 15s.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：双人套餐
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: A Set for Two
quickAssist.trigger: 当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
quickAssist.triggerEn: When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

defensiveAssist.name: 招架支援：防守战术
defensiveAssist.trigger: 前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
defensiveAssist.triggerEn: When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
defensiveAssist.description:
前场角色即将被攻击时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
招架敌人的攻击，累积大量失衡值；
具有较为优秀的招架性能，承受高强度攻击时[支援点数]的消耗量降低；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
defensiveAssist.descriptionEn:
When the character on field is about to be attacked, press [Switch] to activate:
Parries the enemy's attack, dealing massive Daze.
This skill excels at parrying enemy attacks and reduces the consumption of Assist Points when the character is under intense attacks.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

assistFollowup.name: 支援突击：席卷打击
assistFollowup.trigger: 发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
assistFollowup.triggerEn: Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
assistFollowup.description:
发动[招架支援]后，点按 【普通攻击键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动突进打击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
招式发动期间长按 【普通攻击键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
assistFollowup.descriptionEn:
Press [Basic Attack] after a Defensive Assist to activate:
Charges and strikes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.
Holding [Basic Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

facts.text: 将武器插入地面变形为旗帜，发动[展旗]攻击，造成冰属性伤害，[展旗]攻击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
facts.textEn: Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Ice DMG. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Quick Assist.

facts.text: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角10%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
facts.textEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 10% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

facts.text: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角20%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
facts.textEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 20% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.

cinema.name: 振奋汇流
cinema.description: 苍角触发[核心被动：刃旗助威]或[额外能力：团膳套餐]时，增益效果的持续时间提升8秒。
cinema.descriptionEn: When Soukaku triggers Core Passive: Blade Banner or Additional Ability: Group Set Meal, the buff duration is increased by 8s.

cinema.name: 实验型充能模块
cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[冲刺攻击]、[闪避反击]、[快速支援]命中敌人时，苍角有15%的概率获得一层[涡流]，1秒内最多触发一次；[涡流]层数到达上限后，若再次获得[涡流]，将改为苍角回复1.2点能量。
cinema.descriptionEn:
When Soukaku's Basic Attack, Dash Attack, Dodge Counter, or Quick Assist hits an enemy, there's a 15% chance she gains 1 stack of Vortex, triggering up to once per second.
When Vortex reaches max stacks, any additional stacks grant Soukaku 1.2 Energy instead.

cinema.description: [普通攻击]、[闪避]、[支援技]、[特殊技]、[连携技] 技能等级+2
cinema.descriptionEn: Basic Attack, Dodge, Assist, Special Attack, and Chain Attack Lv. +2

cinema.descriptionEn: If an enemy is hit by Fly the Flag, the target's Ice RES is reduced by 10% for 8s.

cinema.description: [霜染刃旗]状态下，强化[普通攻击]和强化[冲刺攻击]的可发动次数提升至12次，且招式造成的伤害提升45%。
cinema.descriptionEn: While in the Frosted Banner state, the number of usable enhanced Basic Attacks and enhanced Dash Attacks is increased to 12, and also deal 45% more DMG.

ex.description:
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将武器插入地面变形为旗帜，发动[展旗]攻击，造成冰属性伤害，[展旗]攻击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
[展旗]攻击后再次点按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 ，将发动一次特殊的收旗攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
发动[展旗]攻击时，若拥有三层[涡流]，则会消耗所有[涡流]，进入[霜染刃旗]状态；[霜染刃旗]状态下，苍角能够发动强化[普通攻击]和强化[冲刺攻击]，造成大量冰属性伤害，最多持续45秒或触发6次；
苍角的武器在以下情况下会获得[涡流]：
发动[强化特殊技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[连携技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[终结技]时，获得三层[涡流]；
[涡流]上限为三层。
ex.descriptionEn:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Ice DMG. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Quick Assist.
Pressing [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] after Fly the Flag activates a Special Attack as she retracts the flag, dealing Ice DMG.
If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of Vortex on using Fly the Flag, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the Frosted Banner state. In the Frosted Banner state, she can unleash an enhanced Basic Attack or an enhanced Dash Attack, dealing massive Ice DMG. This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times.
Soukaku's weapon gains Vortexes in the following circumstances:
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching an EX Special Attack,
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching a Chain Attack,
Gains 3 stacks of Vortex when launching an Ultimate.
Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of Vortex.

喧响等级达到[极]时，点按 【终结技键】 发动：
快速对前方敌人发动更多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动时，苍角会进入[鬼面]状态，使自身的暴击率提升15%，持续15秒；
招式发动时，队伍中其他角色回复10点能量，下一名换入前场的角色额外回复20点能量；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
ultimate.descriptionEn:
When Decibel Rating is at Maximum, press [Ultimate] to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes an extended series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Upon activating this skill, Soukaku enters the Masked state, increasing her CRIT Rate by 15% for 15s.
Upon activating this skill, other squad members recover 10 Energy. The next character to switch in gains an additional 20 Energy.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

quickAssist.name: 快速支援：双人套餐
quickAssist.nameEn: Quick Assist: A Set for Two
quickAssist.description:
当前操作中的角色被击飞时，点按 【切换键】 发动：
对前方敌人发动斩击，造成冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
quickAssist.descriptionEn:
When the active character is launched, press [Switch] to activate:
Slashes enemies in front, dealing Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

113100004.name: 强化特殊技：扇走蚊虫
113100004.description:
能量足够时，点按 【强化特殊技键】 发动：
向前方扇出范围更远的风场，造成大量冰属性伤害；
多次点按可以连续发动招式，每次发动时将消耗一定能量，能量不足或停止点按时会自动释放终结一击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间抗打断等级提升，受到的伤害降低40%；
招式发动期间长按 【特殊技键】 ，可以快速衔接[展旗]攻击。
113100004.descriptionEn:
With enough Energy, press [EX Special Attack] to activate:
Releases wind currents of extended range in front of her, dealing massive Ice DMG.
This skill can be triggered consecutively by pressing repeatedly. Each use consumes a specified amount of Energy. When Soukaku's Energy is depleted, or you stop pressing the button, she unleashes a powerful finishing move that deals massive Ice DMG.
During skill activation, Anti-Interrupt level increases, and DMG taken is reduced by 40%.
Holding [Special Attack] while using this skill allows for a quick transition to Fly the Flag.

113100005.name: 特殊技：集合啦！
113100005.description:
长按 【特殊技键】 发动：
将武器插入地面变形为旗帜，发动[展旗]攻击，造成冰属性伤害，[展旗]攻击命中敌人时，将触发[快速支援]；
[展旗]攻击后再次点按 【普通攻击键】 或 【特殊技键】 ，将发动一次特殊的收旗攻击，造成冰属性伤害；
发动[展旗]攻击时，若拥有三层[涡流]，则会消耗所有[涡流]，进入[霜染刃旗]状态；[霜染刃旗]状态下，苍角能够发动强化[普通攻击]和强化[冲刺攻击]，造成大量冰属性伤害，最多持续45秒或触发6次；
苍角的武器在以下情况下会获得[涡流]：
发动[强化特殊技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[连携技]时，获得一层[涡流]；
发动[终结技]时，获得三层[涡流]；
[涡流]上限为三层。
113100005.descriptionEn:
Hold [Special Attack] to activate:
Soukaku plunges her weapon into the ground, morphs it into a flag, and launches Fly the Flag, dealing Ice DMG. Hitting an enemy with Fly the Flag triggers a Quick Assist.
Pressing [Basic Attack] or [Special Attack] after Fly the Flag activates a Special Attack as she retracts the flag, dealing Ice DMG.
If Soukaku owns 3 stacks of Vortex on using Fly the Flag, she consumes all 3 stacks and enters the Frosted Banner state. In the Frosted Banner state, she can unleash an enhanced Basic Attack or an enhanced Dash Attack, dealing massive Ice DMG. This effect can last up to 45s or stack up to 6 times.
Soukaku's weapon gains Vortexes in the following circumstances:
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching an EX Special Attack,
Gains 1 stack of Vortex when launching a Chain Attack,
Gains 3 stacks of Vortex when launching an Ultimate.
Soukaku can accumulate a maximum of 3 stacks of Vortex.

113100010.name: 连携技：鹅鸡斩
113100010.description:
触发[连携技]时，选择对应角色发动：
快速对前方敌人发动多次打击，随后衔接[展旗]攻击，造成大量冰属性伤害；
招式发动期间拥有无敌效果。
113100010.descriptionEn:
When a Chain Attack is triggered, select the character to activate:
Soukaku quickly unleashes a series of strikes at enemies in front of her and follows up with Fly the Flag, dealing massive Ice DMG.
Character is invulnerable while using this skill.

113100005.trigger: 长按 【特殊技键】 发动：

1131-core-14.name: 核心被动：刃旗助威
1131-core-14.description: 苍角发动[展旗]时，自身攻击力提升，提升数值等同于苍角10%初始攻击力，最高不超过500点，持续22秒，发动[展旗]并消耗[涡流]时，该增益效果翻倍，最高不超过1000点。队伍中其他角色通过[展旗]所触发的[快速支援]或[连携技]入场时，该增益效果将传递给对应的角色，并刷新其持续时间。
1131-core-14.descriptionEn: When Soukaku launches Fly the Flag, her ATK is increased by 10% of her initial ATK, up to 500, for 22s. When consuming Vortex during Fly the Flag, the ATK increase is doubled, up to a max of 1,000. This buff can be passed along to characters switching in via Quick Assists or Chain Attacks triggered by Fly the Flag, and it refreshes the duration of the buff.
